PM Modi's Birthday Marked by Large-Scale Lamp Lighting Events

Prime Minister Narendra Modi's birthday was observed with significant lamp-lighting ceremonies in multiple locations. In Kharora, an event called 'Ashirwad ka Diya' illuminated the Atal Parisar, while on the banks of the Kharun River, 1.25 lakh lamps were lit for a grand 'Deepotsav'. Chief Minister Bhupesh Baghel participated in the latter event, which also included a 'Maha Aarti'.
